test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d0e3c1e4e0e8fded8138e283f732cadcd2f04904ca23c14f95ed17e88ff67a7.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) New symbol added in right upper corner in every next figure.

2) Triangle is shift left bottom corner in second figure, then shift right bottom corner in third figure at last removed from the series.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0bfb36ba0f3578dcdc586ee7d25d495edf12244e90fdb8981bf1b56f7af1e4f.png] is shift right bottom corner in second figure, then removed from the series.

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/542e5b63557603ef016e4e2f6896e9947152dd311107d2bdb06cbed0a56607a7.png] is removed form the series in second figure.

5) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7da1b8d3a38e878abffda631536340cb4d004341164a88121bb8a40611a8609c.png] is shift left upper corner in second figure, then shift left bottom corner in third figure, then shift right bottom corner in fourth figure at last removed form the series.

6) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab6632821c8c88587b6266a3541def48d57ac55455942590fc0b3f44d9654f29.png] is shift left upper corner in third figure, then shift left bottom corner in fourth figure, then shift right bottom corner in fifth figure at last removed form the series.

7) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb0a1a538ea1b691acaa8ea55a3ef7e55901e07e30cfc435bb74eea2df474178.png] is shift left upper corner in fourth figure, then shift left bottom corner in fifth figure, then shift right bottom corner in sixth figure.

8) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f21ae5e68b4f82bfb9833ba302f22d2f9ab282e4b24b6cf95c17c444c72ae85.png] is shift left upper corner in fifth figure, then shift left bottom corner in sixth figure.

9) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94c75bd1deaf002510e4146438c85694a77dd39f39329352819816c917c9f62f.png] is shift left upper corner in sixth figure.

10) Middle figure is rotate 90º clockwise direction, first figure it is blank then second figure it's back is colored with black color and so on. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2662bb47d93dd8990856e09f53c1246e03277f7f2714952acba5ac626ff244ac.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
